neighbours.label: the word just before an embedded clause with a pronoun subject ('any way she can', 'feel they can', 'tell what'): a clause about what someone can do or think
fire: He promised to help the family in any way he could.
Some patients do not feel they can speak openly with doctors.
The coach will support the players in whatever way they need.
Kids often do not feel they are allowed to say no.
She tried every way she could think of to fix the leak.
From his face I could tell what he was thinking.
Voters rarely feel they have any real say in the outcome.
We will protect our town in any way we can.
